remarks: A renovated 1 bedroom + 1 room that can be used as a den/guest/office space and 1 full bathroom apartment in Norwalk, offering 650 sq ft of living space. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances including microwave, refrigerator and gas range. Two rooms with large windows for bright, natural lighting. Gas heating in the unit. Includes 1 off-street parking space during non-business hours. No laundry facilities on-site, but a laundromat is located nearby. Easy commuting with entrance to I-95, Route 7, and Merritt Parkway close by. Renter responsible for all utilities: gas, electric, internet, etc. A 2-month security deposit required at lease signing. No smoking allowed.
